bank.first: exact reviewed CM43 neighborhood and scale
bank.order: baseline then neighbors, power, axis weights, scale; retain any duplicate baseline

diagnostic: original training records with their multiplicities; exclude the queried observed source state; canonical margin24 conjugate head with the full raw-vocabulary CE denominator
caveat: discovery uses all training records, not a leave-one-out refit; canonical-head optimization is transferred to the frozen actual source head and gives no unseen-accuracy guarantee
selection: lowest original-record diagnostic CE; baseline-first strict improvement greater than 1e-10 for vertices and retained epoch endpoints
full: start from best vertex;64 conditional-gradient steps; direction minimizes complete coefficient slope; line search on the current original-record batch
mini: start from best vertex;8 epochs in original record order at the declared batch size with actual short tails; retain lowest full diagnostic CE among start and epoch endpoints
forward: best bank vertex by forward diagnostic CE; zero new derivatives and optimizer updates
applicability: only previously interpolated unseen ambiguous matched rows; observed, unmodified and unsupported domains retain the reviewed parent
inference: mix actual complex source features before the unchanged complete real/imaginary coefficient product; no extra output decoder
binding: external parent digest and endpoint metadata; deterministic reconstruction of bank, diagnostic optimization, rows and costs on loading
original_comparison: separate after component review; all35 tasks,both policies,full/mini/forward,all baselines and regressions; freeze before heldout evaluation
